active_sprint.name: PB07_LOW_POWER_REBASELINE_TO_G1
active_sprint.completion_target: Re-close G0/G1 for the 1.5-3.0 kW product family before G2 or component-bearing U1 allocation.

tasks.title: PB07 mission, payload and MTOW envelope
tasks.acceptance: 1.5-3.0 kW family has frozen payload/MTOW band, mass budget, duration and environment.
tasks.remaining: Aggregate power and 10-minute/reserve targets are controlled. Exact payload, MTOW, mass allocation and environment are open.

tasks.title: PB07 Quad vs Hexa rotor architecture trade
tasks.acceptance: Rotor count, thrust margin, hover/max thrust per rotor and degraded-mode policy are frozen for PB07.
tasks.remaining: Hexa is leading candidate and Quad alternate. Manufacturer-curve MTOW screens exist, but no architecture is frozen.

tasks.title: Current low-power UAV propulsion market benchmark
tasks.acceptance: At least two current propulsion references have source-backed voltage, power and thrust data.
tasks.closure_note: Satisfied for PB07 by current Hobbywing X8 G2 12S and T-Motor U8 Lite 12S manufacturer data. Historical heavy-lift benchmark remains preserved separately.

tasks.title: PB07 motor and propeller operating-point selection
tasks.acceptance: Hover and max-thrust operating points are selected with exact motor/propeller speed, power and current.
tasks.remaining: 28-30 inch / 85-110KV / 12S-class are benchmark candidates only. Exact production motor/prop MPN remains open.

tasks.title: PB07 battery voltage and energy architecture
tasks.acceptance: Series count, bus min/nom/max, pack current, energy, sag, mass and disconnect behavior are defined.
tasks.remaining: 12S is leading and 14S alternate. P50B 12S3P/4P are calculation candidates. Exact pack remains open.

tasks.title: PB07 ESC electrical envelope
tasks.acceptance: Per-channel continuous/peak DC power/current, phase current, eRPM, PWM candidates and transient voltage are frozen from PB07 propulsion evidence.
tasks.remaining: Old heavy-lift per-ESC/phase-current values are retired. New values await rotor count, bus and exact motor selection.

tasks.title: Faz2/Faz3/B1 keep-recalculate-replace review for PB07
tasks.acceptance: Every critical legacy design choice is reclassified against the low-power PB07 envelope.
tasks.remaining: The old ~3 kW / ~48 V B1 power stage is newly relevant as a candidate, but requires requalification before reuse.

tasks.title: Power semiconductor and topology trade study
tasks.acceptance: Voltage class, switch count, hot conduction/switching loss, SOA and transient margin are calculated.
tasks.remaining: Old >=150 V requirement is retired. 80/100 V-class devices may re-enter only after new bus/transient closure.

tasks.title: PWM frequency and current-ripple study
tasks.acceptance: PWM is selected using exact motor inductance, switching loss, ripple, control bandwidth and acoustics.

tasks.title: MCU and gate-driver architecture selection
tasks.acceptance: MCU and gate driver are selected with timing, voltage, trip and availability evidence.

tasks.title: Current sensing design closure
tasks.acceptance: Shunt/sensor range, power, gain, bandwidth, ADC range, calibration and trip threshold are proven.

tasks.title: DC-link, precharge and regenerative energy design
tasks.acceptance: Capacitance/ripple/ESR/life, precharge, battery disconnect and overvoltage energy path are closed.

tasks.title: Thermal model and cooling architecture
tasks.acceptance: MOSFET, sensor, DC-link and PCB/baseplate losses have nominal/hot/worst-case temperatures and derating limits.

tasks.title: Protection and fault tree/FMEA
tasks.acceptance: Failure modes, detection, hardware/firmware response and safe-state policy are documented.

tasks.title: Create UAV schematic revision
tasks.acceptance: First PB07 component-bearing schematic revision is allocated only after G1/G2 readiness is PASS.

tasks.title: Close production-intent BOM and footprints
tasks.acceptance: All critical components have exact MPN, footprint and derating evidence.

tasks.title: Create buildable firmware tree
tasks.acceptance: Reproducible build, PWM/ADC, driver, CAN, fault manager and tests exist.

tasks.title: Implement motor-control bring-up path
tasks.acceptance: Low-voltage open-loop through FOC/SVPWM test modes are available.

tasks.title: Control PCB final design
tasks.acceptance: Placement/routing and critical analog/digital/interface review are closed.

tasks.title: Power PCB / bus structure design
tasks.acceptance: Power/gate loops, Kelvin paths, current sharing and thermal/mechanical current paths pass review.

tasks.title: Manufacturing package and DFM
tasks.acceptance: Gerber/drill/BOM/PnP/assembly/fab notes and DFM evidence are complete.

tasks.title: Low-energy hardware bring-up
tasks.acceptance: Rails, reset, MCU, gate driver, fault inputs and PWM inhibit are verified before power switching.

tasks.title: Switching and protection validation
tasks.acceptance: Gate/switch-node waveforms, overshoot, dead-time, sensing and hardware-trip latency are measured.

tasks.title: Dyno / guarded prop stand validation
tasks.acceptance: Hover, continuous and peak PB07 operating points are physically demonstrated.

tasks.title: UAV integration and flight-test readiness review
tasks.acceptance: Propulsion, arming/failsafe, harness, thermal and configuration-control evidence are complete before flight.
